name: advise-single-opus
description: Council advisor, the one-seat control on Claude Opus 5.5 (experimental; brief 24's arm A). The caller of the add-on is usually Claude already, so this is NOT the add-on's default: it exists so one Anthropic seat can be compared with the same brief, prompt and answer field. Opus 5.5 through OpenRouter, routed only to endpoints OpenRouter tags zero-data-retention. advise.usd is this call's own ceiling. maxRounds is unused by advise chains.
